name: extraction-arena
description: Eval harness for document extraction pipelines scored against a golden dataset. Root scripts only — backend/ and frontend/ remain independent packages.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
